household.label: Food & beverages
household.description: Tariff-exposed: packaged and processed foods with imported inputs, beverages, and some imported produce. Less exposed: mostly domestic unprocessed staples; dining labor and non-imported services are outside this goods-focused estimate.

household.label: Apparel
household.description: Tariff-exposed: clothing, footwear, and accessories with imported content. Less exposed: alterations, rentals, and secondhand purchases with minimal new-import value.

household.label: Electronics
household.description: Tariff-exposed: devices, accessories, and imported components in finished goods. Less exposed: pure software subscriptions and domestically sourced services with no hardware spend.

household.label: Vehicles & parts
household.description: Tariff-exposed: vehicles, tires, and parts with global supply chains. Less exposed: insurance, financing, and purely local labor-only repairs with no imported parts.

household.label: Furniture
household.description: Tariff-exposed: imported and import-heavy furniture and mattresses. Less exposed: used furniture and custom local woodwork with domestic materials only.

household.label: Household appliances
household.description: Tariff-exposed: large and small appliances and replacement parts crossing borders. Less exposed: installation labor only (no product purchase) and extended warranties priced separately as services.

household.label: Personal care
household.description: Tariff-exposed: OTC, cosmetics, and grooming products with imported materials or finished imports. Less exposed: purely local salon labor with no retail product spend in this category.

household.label: Toys
household.description: Tariff-exposed: toys, games, and collectibles with imported manufacturing. Less exposed: digital-only games and local experiences with no physical goods purchase.

household.label: Home improvement
household.description: Tariff-exposed: tools, hardware, paint, lumber, and project materials with import content. Less exposed: contractor labor billed separately with no materials purchased by you.

household.label: Recreation
household.description: Tariff-exposed: imported sporting goods, outdoor gear, and physical hobby products (including electronics in this basket). Less exposed: gym memberships, lessons, and other services with no goods spend.

industry.label: Agriculture & food processing
industry.description: Crop and animal inputs, fertilizer, and packaged food manufacturing. Tariff-exposed: imported inputs (e.g., fertilizer, equipment parts) and trade-linked commodity costs.

industry.label: Textiles & apparel manufacturing
industry.description: Yarn, fabric, cut-and-sew, and branded apparel. Tariff-exposed: yarn and fabric imports, finished apparel sourcing, and retaliatory or input tariffs on fibers.

industry.label: Automotive & parts
industry.description: OEM assembly, tier suppliers, and aftermarket. Tariff-exposed: cross-border parts flows, steel/aluminum content, and country-specific auto tariffs.

industry.label: Electronics manufacturing
industry.description: Devices, boards, assembly, and test. High exposure due to reliance on Chinese components, semiconductors, and finished goods imports.

industry.label: Machinery & equipment
industry.description: Industrial machinery, tools, and capital equipment. Tariff-exposed: imported subsystems, precision components, and metals subject to Section 232 or country measures.

industry.label: Chemicals & materials
industry.description: Commodity and specialty chemicals, plastics, and inputs. Tariff-exposed: feedstock and specialty imports, plus energy-linked input volatility passed through trade rules.

industry.label: Construction & building products
industry.description: Lumber, steel, fixtures, and engineered materials. Tariff-exposed: lumber, steel, and imported fixtures where domestic capacity does not fully substitute.

industry.label: Retail & wholesale trade
industry.description: Distribution and merchandising of imported goods. Tariff-exposed: landed cost of imports dominates COGS; margins compress when pass-through lags tariff hikes.

industry.label: Transportation & logistics
industry.description: Freight, warehousing, and port-related activity. Tariff-exposed: import volumes, equipment with imported content, and fuel or chassis tied to trade policy indirectly.

industry.label: Other services & mixed
industry.description: Services and sectors with limited direct tariff exposure. Tariff-exposed only where imported intermediates or trade-linked demand still hit revenue or costs.
